# Markdown specification examples

Each UTF-8 JSON line holds the Markdown input and expected HTML for one numbered example. Line numbers match the example numbers. CommonMark examples were extracted from the [0.31.2 specification JSON](https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/spec.json). GFM examples were extracted from the two source columns in the [0.29-gfm specification](https://github.github.com/gfm/), decoding HTML entities, space markers and the visible tab marker.

Specification examples are from John MacFarlane and the CommonMark contributors, and GitHub and the GFM contributors, under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). The original expected HTML is a fixture only and is never executed.
